problem_statement: themewagon/smart-home is a Next.js smart-home dashboard (React 19 + Tailwind, static export) with a purple-branded sidebar shell (Home, Messages, Statistics, Security, Devices, Profile) wrapping a card-based widget zone. The Devices screen lists every connected device the hub controls. Add a genre-native Device filter to the Devices screen: a control bar mounted directly above the device grid with category chips (All, Lighting, Climate, Appliance, Security, Entertainment) and a live result readout 'Showing N of 9 . <Category>'. Clicking a chip must filter the device grid to that type AND recompute the readout (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 9 . Security'). The same filter appears as a compact device-summary rail on the Dashboard home and Statistics screens so the resident always sees the fleet size. The chip row must be responsive (wrap on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow), the device grid must render as a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles and readable active-chip contrast, and the rail must be present on all three screens. Keep the dashboard's purple design language, sidebar, and the surrounding widgets intact.
required_content: The Devices screen shows a 'Device filter' control bar above a grid of 9 connected devices, each labelled with its room and type.
Category chips (All, Lighting, Climate, Appliance, Security, Entertainment) filter the device grid, and a live readout reads 'Showing N of 9 . <Category>'.
Clicking a category chip filters the grid AND updates the readout count/label; clicking Security yields 'Showing 2 of 9 . Security'.
The Device filter summary rail is present on the Devices, Dashboard, and Statistics screens (cross-screen continuity).
At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow; the device grid stays a tidy, legible multi-column grid on desktop with readable active-chip contrast.
No JavaScript console errors or failed network requests are introduced on any captured screen.
design_constraints: Preserve the smart-home dashboard design language: purple brand, rounded card widgets, muted greys, the sidebar shell and topbar.
The Device filter must ride at the top of the device grid it controls (Devices screen) and as a compact summary rail on Dashboard + Statistics; do not turn it into a hero or a separate page.
The category chip row must be responsive (wrap / flexible chips), not a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the mobile viewport.
The device grid must be a tidy multi-column grid; cards must not shingle or overlap via negative margins, and card titles / active-chip text must stay legible (no near-white-on-near-white).
Clicking a chip must recompute the readout from the active category; a frozen/stale readout that never updates is a defect.
Only the Device-filter component, its stylesheet, the surface whitelist, and the devices page dataset change between legs; the shared shell stays the same.
state_constraints: desktop_devices captures the Devices screen at 1440px: the Device filter bar renders its six category chips in one tidy responsive row above a legible three-column device grid, active chip readable, readout 'Showing 9 of 9 . All devices'.

mobile_devices captures the Devices screen at 390px: the responsive chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow (a fixed-width nowrap chip row would push the document wider than the viewport).
desktop_dashboard and desktop_statistics capture the Dashboard and Statistics screens, each showing the Device filter summary rail (cross-screen continuity).
desktop_devices_security captures the Devices screen after clicking the Security chip: the grid filters to 2 devices and the readout recomputes to 'Showing 2 of 9 . Security'.

Source inspection confirms a Next.js static-export dashboard; the Device filter lives in components/devices/device-filter.tsx, its layout in app/device-filter.css, and its cross-screen presence in lib/filter-surfaces.ts.

change_completion: The Devices screen shows the Device filter bar with six category chips and a live 'Showing N of 9 . <Category>' readout above a 9-device grid.
Clicking the Security chip filters the grid to 2 devices and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 9 . Security'.
The Device filter summary rail appears on the Devices, Dashboard, and Statistics screens.
design_consistency: The filter keeps the dashboard's purple brand, rounded card widgets, and sidebar shell.
The device grid is a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles and readable active-chip contrast (no overlap, no near-white-on-near-white).
Desktop and tablet appearance of the filter and grid are preserved.
regression: The sidebar navigation, topbar, dashboard widgets, and charts remain functional and reachable.
No console errors or failed network requests are introduced on any captured screen.
responsive: At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow or clipped chips.
The device grid collapses cleanly to fewer columns on mobile without overlapping cards.
